admins.name: admins_user_id_fkey
admins.defn: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

connector_status_events.name: connector_status_events_charge_point_id_fkey
connector_status_events.defn: FOREIGN KEY (charge_point_id) REFERENCES charge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

connectors.name: connectors_charge_point_id_fkey
connectors.defn: FOREIGN KEY (charge_point_id) REFERENCES charge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

credit_accounts.name: credit_accounts_closure_refunded_check
credit_accounts.defn: CHECK (((closure_refunded_at IS NULL) OR ((closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closure_refunded_at >= closed_at))))

credit_transactions.name: credit_transactions_credit_account_id_fkey
credit_transactions.defn: FOREIGN KEY (credit_account_id) REFERENCES credit_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

driver_stop_attempts.name: driver_stop_attempts_check
driver_stop_attempts.defn: CHECK ((((kind)::text <> 'operator_recovery'::text) OR ((previous_command_id IS NOT NULL) AND (connection_epoch IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence_meter_id IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence_received_at IS NOT NULL) AND (operator_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (note IS NOT NULL))))

drivers.name: drivers_user_id_fkey
drivers.defn: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

e_invoices.name: e_invoices_issued_check
e_invoices.defn: CHECK (((status <> 'issued'::e_invoice_status) OR ((invoice_no IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_at IS NOT NULL))))

e_invoices.name: e_invoices_last_error_check
e_invoices.defn: CHECK (((last_error_kind IS NULL) OR (last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)))

e_invoices.name: e_invoices_next_attempt_check
e_invoices.defn: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['requested'::e_invoice_status, 'failed'::e_invoice_status])) OR (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)))

invoice_adjustments.name: invoice_adjustments_e_invoice_id_fkey
invoice_adjustments.defn: FOREIGN KEY (e_invoice_id) REFERENCES e_invoices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

invoice_adjustments.name: invoice_adjustments_issued_check
invoice_adjustments.defn: CHECK (((status <> 'issued'::e_invoice_status) OR ((issued_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_adjustment_no IS NOT NULL))))

invoice_adjustments.name: invoice_adjustments_last_error_check
invoice_adjustments.defn: CHECK (((last_error_kind IS NULL) OR (last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)))

invoice_adjustments.name: invoice_adjustments_next_attempt_check
invoice_adjustments.defn: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['requested'::e_invoice_status, 'failed'::e_invoice_status])) OR (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)))

loyalty_transactions.name: loyalty_transactions_loyalty_account_id_fkey
loyalty_transactions.defn: FOREIGN KEY (loyalty_account_id) REFERENCES loyalty_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

meter_values.name: meter_values_session_id_fkey
meter_values.defn: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

ocpp_message_log.name: ocpp_message_log_action_check
ocpp_message_log.defn: CHECK (((validation_error IS NOT NULL) OR ((message_type = 2) = (action IS NOT NULL))))

ocpp_message_log.name: ocpp_message_log_message_type_check
ocpp_message_log.defn: CHECK ((((message_type IS NOT NULL) AND (message_type = ANY (ARRAY[2, 3, 4]))) OR ((message_type IS NULL) AND (validation_error IS NOT NULL))))

operator_staff.name: operator_staff_user_id_fkey
operator_staff.defn: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

reconciliation_records.name: reconciliation_records_session_id_fkey
reconciliation_records.defn: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

refunds.name: refunds_last_error_check
refunds.defn: CHECK (((last_error_kind IS NULL) OR (last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)))

remote_commands.name: remote_commands_responded_check
remote_commands.defn: CHECK (((responded_at IS NULL) OR ((sent_at IS NOT NULL) AND (responded_at >= sent_at))))

session_pauses.name: session_pauses_session_id_fkey
session_pauses.defn: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

session_status_history.name: session_status_history_session_id_fkey
session_status_history.defn: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

session_tariff_segments.name: session_tariff_segments_session_id_fkey
session_tariff_segments.defn: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

sessions.name: sessions_connector_fk
sessions.defn: FOREIGN KEY (connector_id, charge_point_id, connector_no) REFERENCES connectors(id, charge_point_id, connector_no)

tariff_periods.name: tariff_periods_operator_id_fkey
tariff_periods.defn: FOREIGN KEY (operator_id) REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

top_ups.name: top_ups_late_payment_check
top_ups.defn: CHECK ((((late_gateway_ref IS NULL) AND (late_paid_at IS NULL) AND (late_amount_vnd IS NULL)) OR ((late_gateway_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (late_paid_at IS NOT NULL) AND (late_amount_vnd IS NOT NULL) AND (late_amount_vnd >= 0))))

top_ups.name: top_ups_late_refunded_check
top_ups.defn: CHECK (((late_refunded_at IS NULL) OR ((late_paid_at IS NOT NULL) AND (late_refunded_at >= late_paid_at))))
